title: MethodRelease
description: An immutable, retrievable detector. Method, not Model: the winning method in this domain is a threshold on a count rate, and a Model-centric vocabulary would structurally privilege machine learning (ADR-0002, ADR-0010).

artifact_digest.description: The serialised method itself. A benchmark whose methods cannot be retrieved is a report.

declared_instruments.description: Every instrument this method consumes. The engine asserts this is a subset of the Protocol's permitted_instruments and refuses to score on mismatch. v1 declared exactly this metadata correctly and never compared it against anything (ADR-0011, SALVAGE-002).

parameters.description: Fitted or chosen parameters. Open by necessity — a method's parameter set is its own, and enumerating them here would make the contract method-specific.

training_provenance.description: The run that produced this release, or null for a method with no fitting step. A threshold detector legitimately has none.
